title: INFG_139
treatment_protocol_ch1: Blood samples from patients and controls were collected and stored in PAX tubes.
extract_protocol_ch1: Whole blood RNA was extracted from PAXgene tubes as described in the manufacturer’s protocol (QIAGEN PreAnalytiX)
extract_protocol_ch1_1: Quality and integrity of total RNA was controlled on Agilent Technologies 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies; Waldbronn, Germany). Library construction: Globin mRNA was depleted from total RNA using GLOBINclear Kit, human (ThermoFisher, Invitrogen). Subsequently, a strand-specific RNA sequencing library was generated using NEBNext® Ultra  II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs) according to manufacturer’s protocols.
extract_protocol_ch1_2: The library was sequenced on Illumina HiSeq 4000 using HiSeq 3000/4000 SBS Kit (300 cycles) with an average of 40 million reads per RNA sample
data_processing: Reads were quality checked with package FastQC (version 0.11.4, reference see link below), then trimmed using Trimgalore (version 0.4.4, reference see link below) with default settings.
data_processing_1: Trimmed reads were mapped to human genome annotation hg38 (ENSMBL hg38 release 91) using STAR (version 2.5.2b, (Dobin and Gingeras, 2015)) with default settings.
data_processing_2: Mapped reads were counted using RsubRead (version 1.32.4, (Liao et al., 2019)). Reads for beta-globin were set to 1000. Raw counts were then normalized using DESeq2 (version 1.16.1, (Love et al., 2014)).
data_processing_3: Sex was validated by gene expression for Y-specific genes and corrected if different from recorded sex. Two strong outliers (assigned as infected but grouping with controls and vice versa) were removed from the dataset after principle component analy
data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: txt matrix with log2 normalized values per sample.

extract_protocol_ch1: Whole blood RNA was extracted from PAXgene tubes as described in the manufacturer’s protocol (QIAGEN PreAnalytiX)
extract_protocol_ch1_1: Quality and integrity of total RNA was controlled on Agilent Technologies 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies; Waldbronn, Germany). Library construction: Globin mRNA was depleted from total RNA using GLOBINclear Kit, human (ThermoFisher, Invitrogen). Subsequently, a strand-specific RNA sequencing library was generated using NEBNext® Ultra  II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs) according to manufacturer’s protocols.
extract_protocol_ch1_2: The library was sequenced on Illumina HiSeq 4000 using HiSeq 3000/4000 SBS Kit (300 cycles) with an average of 40 million reads per RNA sample
data_processing: Reads were quality checked with package FastQC (version 0.11.4, reference see link below), then trimmed using Trimgalore (version 0.4.4, reference see link below) with default settings.
data_processing_1: Trimmed reads were mapped to human genome annotation hg38 (ENSMBL hg38 release 91) using STAR (version 2.5.2b, (Dobin and Gingeras, 2015)) with default settings.
data_processing_2: Mapped reads were counted using RsubRead (version 1.32.4, (Liao et al., 2019)). Reads for beta-globin were set to 1000. Raw counts were then normalized using DESeq2 (version 1.16.1, (Love et al., 2014)).
data_processing_3: Sex was validated by gene expression for Y-specific genes and corrected if different from recorded sex. Two strong outliers (assigned as infected but grouping with controls and vice versa) were removed from the dataset after principle component analy
data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: txt matrix with log2 normalized values per sample.

title: WIMR_058
treatment_protocol_ch1: Blood samples from patients and controls were collected and stored in PAX tubes.
extract_protocol_ch1: Whole blood RNA was extracted from PAXgene tubes as described in the manufacturer’s protocol (QIAGEN PreAnalytiX)
extract_protocol_ch1_1: Quality and integrity of total RNA was controlled on Agilent Technologies 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies; Waldbronn, Germany). Library construction: Globin mRNA was depleted from total RNA using GLOBINclear Kit, human (ThermoFisher, Invitrogen). Subsequently, a strand-specific RNA sequencing library was generated using NEBNext® Ultra  II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs) according to manufacturer’s protocols.
extract_protocol_ch1_2: The library was sequenced on Illumina HiSeq 4000 using HiSeq 3000/4000 SBS Kit (300 cycles) with an average of 40 million reads per RNA sample
data_processing: Reads were quality checked with package FastQC (version 0.11.4, reference see link below), then trimmed using Trimgalore (version 0.4.4, reference see link below) with default settings.
data_processing_1: Trimmed reads were mapped to human genome annotation hg38 (ENSMBL hg38 release 91) using STAR (version 2.5.2b, (Dobin and Gingeras, 2015)) with default settings.
data_processing_2: Mapped reads were counted using RsubRead (version 1.32.4, (Liao et al., 2019)). Reads for beta-globin were set to 1000. Raw counts were then normalized using DESeq2 (version 1.16.1, (Love et al., 2014)).
data_processing_3: Sex was validated by gene expression for Y-specific genes and corrected if different from recorded sex. Two strong outliers (assigned as infected but grouping with controls and vice versa) were removed from the dataset after principle component analy
data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: txt matrix with log2 normalized values per sample.

title: WIMR_063
treatment_protocol_ch1: Blood samples from patients and controls were collected and stored in PAX tubes.
extract_protocol_ch1: Whole blood RNA was extracted from PAXgene tubes as described in the manufacturer’s protocol (QIAGEN PreAnalytiX)
extract_protocol_ch1_1: Quality and integrity of total RNA was controlled on Agilent Technologies 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies; Waldbronn, Germany). Library construction: Globin mRNA was depleted from total RNA using GLOBINclear Kit, human (ThermoFisher, Invitrogen). Subsequently, a strand-specific RNA sequencing library was generated using NEBNext® Ultra  II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs) according to manufacturer’s protocols.
extract_protocol_ch1_2: The library was sequenced on Illumina HiSeq 4000 using HiSeq 3000/4000 SBS Kit (300 cycles) with an average of 40 million reads per RNA sample
data_processing: Reads were quality checked with package FastQC (version 0.11.4, reference see link below), then trimmed using Trimgalore (version 0.4.4, reference see link below) with default settings.
data_processing_1: Trimmed reads were mapped to human genome annotation hg38 (ENSMBL hg38 release 91) using STAR (version 2.5.2b, (Dobin and Gingeras, 2015)) with default settings.
data_processing_2: Mapped reads were counted using RsubRead (version 1.32.4, (Liao et al., 2019)). Reads for beta-globin were set to 1000. Raw counts were then normalized using DESeq2 (version 1.16.1, (Love et al., 2014)).
data_processing_3: Sex was validated by gene expression for Y-specific genes and corrected if different from recorded sex. Two strong outliers (assigned as infected but grouping with controls and vice versa) were removed from the dataset after principle component analy
data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: txt matrix with log2 normalized values per sample.

title: WIMR_084
treatment_protocol_ch1: Blood samples from patients and controls were collected and stored in PAX tubes.
extract_protocol_ch1: Whole blood RNA was extracted from PAXgene tubes as described in the manufacturer’s protocol (QIAGEN PreAnalytiX)
extract_protocol_ch1_1: Quality and integrity of total RNA was controlled on Agilent Technologies 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies; Waldbronn, Germany). Library construction: Globin mRNA was depleted from total RNA using GLOBINclear Kit, human (ThermoFisher, Invitrogen). Subsequently, a strand-specific RNA sequencing library was generated using NEBNext® Ultra  II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs) according to manufacturer’s protocols.
extract_protocol_ch1_2: The library was sequenced on Illumina HiSeq 4000 using HiSeq 3000/4000 SBS Kit (300 cycles) with an average of 40 million reads per RNA sample
data_processing: Reads were quality checked with package FastQC (version 0.11.4, reference see link below), then trimmed using Trimgalore (version 0.4.4, reference see link below) with default settings.
data_processing_1: Trimmed reads were mapped to human genome annotation hg38 (ENSMBL hg38 release 91) using STAR (version 2.5.2b, (Dobin and Gingeras, 2015)) with default settings.
data_processing_2: Mapped reads were counted using RsubRead (version 1.32.4, (Liao et al., 2019)). Reads for beta-globin were set to 1000. Raw counts were then normalized using DESeq2 (version 1.16.1, (Love et al., 2014)).
data_processing_3: Sex was validated by gene expression for Y-specific genes and corrected if different from recorded sex. Two strong outliers (assigned as infected but grouping with controls and vice versa) were removed from the dataset after principle component analy
data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: txt matrix with log2 normalized values per sample.

title: WIMR_089
treatment_protocol_ch1: Blood samples from patients and controls were collected and stored in PAX tubes.
extract_protocol_ch1: Whole blood RNA was extracted from PAXgene tubes as described in the manufacturer’s protocol (QIAGEN PreAnalytiX)
extract_protocol_ch1_1: Quality and integrity of total RNA was controlled on Agilent Technologies 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies; Waldbronn, Germany). Library construction: Globin mRNA was depleted from total RNA using GLOBINclear Kit, human (ThermoFisher, Invitrogen). Subsequently, a strand-specific RNA sequencing library was generated using NEBNext® Ultra  II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs) according to manufacturer’s protocols.
extract_protocol_ch1_2: The library was sequenced on Illumina HiSeq 4000 using HiSeq 3000/4000 SBS Kit (300 cycles) with an average of 40 million reads per RNA sample
data_processing: Reads were quality checked with package FastQC (version 0.11.4, reference see link below), then trimmed using Trimgalore (version 0.4.4, reference see link below) with default settings.
data_processing_1: Trimmed reads were mapped to human genome annotation hg38 (ENSMBL hg38 release 91) using STAR (version 2.5.2b, (Dobin and Gingeras, 2015)) with default settings.
data_processing_2: Mapped reads were counted using RsubRead (version 1.32.4, (Liao et al., 2019)). Reads for beta-globin were set to 1000. Raw counts were then normalized using DESeq2 (version 1.16.1, (Love et al., 2014)).
data_processing_3: Sex was validated by gene expression for Y-specific genes and corrected if different from recorded sex. Two strong outliers (assigned as infected but grouping with controls and vice versa) were removed from the dataset after principle component analy
data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: txt matrix with log2 normalized values per sample.
